page.overview:
What is Frozen?

Beauty and the Beast Cinderella The Little Mermaid Moana Mulan Sleeping Beauty Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs Tangled Whisker HavenDisney 100

Frozen is a licensed sub-theme of Disney that was introduced in 2015 under the Disney Princess theme. Since its introduction Frozen has been a part of multiple themes such as BrickHeadz, Juniors and Minifigures.
